title: Feature specification
description: One specification, as `.ai/specs/<slug>.md` or as an inline entity block. This is one of the four ID kinds with a *named* suffix rather than a number, so `SPEC-context` is valid and `SPEC-007` is not: the slug is how a reader refers to a feature in prose, and forcing it into a number would make every sentence about it an ID lookup.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case slug. `SPEC-context` and `SPEC-auth-missing` are valid; `SPEC-Context` is not, because a path built from the ID would then differ per platform.

depends_on.description: Acyclic by rule; a cycle is CTX-010.
